targets.authors: Schindl M, Wassipaul S, Wagner T, Gstaltner K, Bethge M
targets.title: Impact of functional capacity evaluation on patient-reported functional ability: an exploratory diagnostic before-after study
targets.evidence_quote: We assessed the reproducibility of the findings of our initial cohort study (recruited in 2016) by following two subsequent patient cohorts (recruited in 2017 and 2018) that completed the same diagnostic before–after study as the initial cohort [ 14 ].
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, a significant increase in patient-reported functional ability after FCE was found in patients with musculoskeletal trauma in the original study, and the results were reproduced in two subsequent cohorts.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall conclusion explicitly confirms the original effect in two new patient cohorts.

reasoning: New patient cohorts re-test the published 2019 finding; this is replication despite the reproducibility terminology.
